description: Checks a list of menu items, and a collection time if one is given, against the menu and the kitchen as they are right now, and returns a link to a ready-filled basket on Dusty's website with the total. Nothing is ordered or charged by this tool: the person opens the link, checks it and pays on the website. Pizzas come as 'Classic' or with a 'Hot honey' crust. Changes to a pizza (for example no basil) are made by the person on the website.

collection_time.description: When the person wants to collect, as HH:MM on the 24-hour restaurant clock (18:30 for half past six in the evening). Left out, the order is for as soon as possible. Orders are taken for the next open evening only, at times on the quarter hour.

name.description: The item's name on Dusty's menu, e.g. Margherita.

option.description: For a pizza: 'Classic' or 'Hot honey'. Leave out for the plain one.

name: start_order
title: Start an order for collection
